requirement: Expand HWPX-to-DOCX editable shape/style transfer beyond the previously supported polygon subset.

supportedTransfer: HWPX inline rectangle to editable DOCX DrawingML preset rect
HWPX inline ellipse to editable DOCX DrawingML preset ellipse
HWPX inline straight line with canonical top-left to bottom-right endpoints to editable DOCX DrawingML preset line
HWPX inline closed filled borderless polygon to editable DOCX DrawingML custom geometry (`a:custGeom`)
implementation.mapping: HWPUNIT dimensions are converted to DOCX point extents and serialized EMU. BGR fill/stroke colors become RGB, solid stroke width is preserved, and supported rotation, flips, and alt description are retained. The native ellipse acceptance covers 90-degree rotation and horizontal flip. The line importer independently requires canonical endpoint geometry and refuses unsupported transforms. Closed filled polygons retain vertex order and the close command as an editable DrawingML path; HWPUNIT coordinates map to EMU at 127 EMU/HWPUNIT, with fill and description preserved.
implementation.preconditions: Only body-owned inline HWPX objects with treatAsChar=true, Square wrap, zero offsets, dimensions 200..14400 HWPUNIT, and no caption/textbox are accepted. The pinned RHWP portable extractor rejects rounded rectangles, unsupported fill/line styles, arrows, effects, and noncanonical line geometry. The DOCX engine independently validates shape kind, colors, dimensions, transforms, and alt text. A loaded DOCX body that fails source-model roundtrip is refused before mutation. Polygon transfer additionally requires 3..256 unique non-collinear in-bounds vertices, no closure duplicate in the portable point list, no rotation/flips, solid fill, and no border.
implementation.preservation: Source HWPX fixture bytes remain unchanged. The destination retains all 9 OPC part names; T009 changes only word/document.xml. Destination text and the preexisting DrawingML identity 1 remain unchanged. New editable shapes receive unique docPr IDs 2, 3, and 4. Undo/Redo, same-process document reopen, and a separate application process reopen preserve editability. The polygon follow-up Native save changed only `word/document.xml`; existing drawing ID 1 remained and the polygon received unique ID 2. The polygon-specific Native case closed/reopened in the same application process and selected the editable shape; independent Rust read and T009 check passed.
implementation.unsupportedCases: Rounded HWPX rectangle is rejected without changing revision, caret, render, or file bytes. A rotated HWPX line is rejected before DOCX mutation by the focused TypeScript regression. An unsafe non-roundtripping DOCX body rejects insertion atomically in Rust. Non-polygon custom/freeform shapes and curves, textboxes, captions, media, noncanonical line geometry, unsupported effects/styles, and unmodeled envelopes remain outside this mapping.

limitations: This is object-level structured transfer, not full-document format conversion.

Only the bounded closed, filled, borderless HWPX polygon maps to editable DrawingML custom geometry. Non-polygon custom/freeform outlines, curves, unsupported metadata/transforms, floating objects, textboxes, captions and media remain rejected.
